notes.title: Like A Dragon: Pirate Yakuza in Hawaii's latest patch ensures Goro Majima's golden balls are no longer unobtainable
notes.content:
Ok, so, as you might be aware, Like A Dragon: Pirate Yakuza In Hawaii contains some golden balls, and they can belong to Goro Majima. Well, provided he goes around and collects all seven of them as part of a sub-story.

notes.title: Like a Dragon Gaiden 1.12 Patch Update
notes.content:
Hello RGG Fans!

Thank you for playing Like a Dragon Gaiden
Patch 1.12 is now live with the following fixes and improvements:

•	Fixed an issue with the game running at double speed in certain environments.
•	Adjusted the bird’s eye camera view while playing pool.
•	Graphics settings in the main game now carry over to the Like a Dragon: Infinite Wealth Special Trial Version.
•	Fixed an issue with the display while using Intel Arc.
•	When anti-aliasing is set to “NVIDIA DLAA” in the graphics settings, sharpness can now be adjusted using the “NVIDIA DLSS Sharpness” slider.
•	Fixed various other issues.

We appreciate your support and patience while our team addresses these known issues.

Please continue to share any bugs you encounter via the Official Bug Thread.

- RGG Community Team -
